hero.heading: Who really knows you?
hero.subheading: Create a fun quiz about yourself, share it with your friends, and discover who understands you best.

howItWorks.title: How VibeCheck works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Answer a few fun questions about yourself and pick the correct choice for each one.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Send your quiz link, QR code, or WhatsApp message to your friends in seconds.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Watch responses roll in and check your private leaderboard as friends compete.

features.title: Everything you need to test your friendships
